articles.title: Burnham pulls back on suggestion to increase income tax allowance
articles.description: The new prime minister previously said voters were frustrated over the freeze in tax-free personal allowance.

articles.title: US renews strikes on Iran as Trump threatens to attack underground nuclear site
articles.description: The US president's threat to target a key Iranian nuclear site came ahead of the 11th consecutive night of attacks.

articles.title: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
articles.description: Oleksandr Syrskyi is dismissed after backlash over the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

articles.title: Ann Widdecombe was hit on head 21 times with hammer, prosecutors say
articles.description: Joshua Kerry, 28, attacked Widdecombe while she was eating lunch at her home in Devon before stealing her wallet, prosecutors say.
